authority: Geotechnical Engineering Office (GEO), Civil Engineering and Development Department (CEDD), Hong Kong
statutory_references: CEDD Geoguide 1: Guide to Retaining Wall Design (2nd Edition)
CEDD Geoguide 5: Guide to Slope Maintenance (3rd Edition)
CEDD Geoguide 7: Guide to Soil Nail Design and Construction (1st Edition)
GEO Report No. 138: Model Specification for Flexible Rockfall and Debris-Resisting Barriers
GEO Technical Guidance Note (TGN) 24: Guidelines on Subsurface Drainage Design

Category_1.criteria: Residential dwellings, schools, hospitals, commercial complexes, or heavily trafficked National Highway corridors where failure poses immediate threat to human life.
Category_1.mandatory_investigation: Detailed Stability Assessment (DSA) & Continuous Displacement Monitoring

Category_2.criteria: Secondary roads (State Highways, Major District Roads), bus stands, open commercial yards, rural bypasses where failure causes severe transit disruption but low direct risk to occupied buildings.
Category_2.mandatory_investigation: Engineer Inspection for Maintenance (EIM) & Preventive Upgrading

Category_3.criteria: Rural link roads (ODR/PMGSY), remote forested slopes, agricultural terraces, or open pasture with no permanently occupied structures.

Category_A.criteria: Critical strategic transport corridor where road closure cost exceeds Rs 5 Crore or causes >7 days inter-state supply disruption.

Category_B.criteria: Secondary transport link with established detour alternatives within 15 km.

Category_C.criteria: Local feeder road with low traffic density (<500 PCU/day) and low repair cost.

reinforcement_bar.steel_grade: High-Yield Deformed Steel Bar (Fe500 / BS 4449 Grade 500B)
reinforcement_bar.corrosion_protection: Hot-dip galvanized (min 610 g/m²) plus corrugated HDPE duct encasement for Category 1 slopes

borehole_specification.drilling_method: Rotary percussion drilling with casing through overburden colluvium

grout_specification.material: Non-shrink neat cementitious grout (Ordinary Portland Cement)
grout_specification.admixtures: Expanding / non-shrink plasticizer (expansion <= 2% to ASTM C940)

head_assembly.bearing_pad: Cast-in-situ reinforced concrete pad (400mm x 400mm x 200mm) Grade C30/37 with T12 mesh
head_assembly.bearing_plate: Hot-dip galvanized structural steel plate (200mm x 200mm x 20mm, Grade S275)
head_assembly.beveled_washer: Cast iron beveled washer compensating for borehole inclination angle
head_assembly.retaining_nut: High-strength galvanized hex nut tightened to 50 Nm seating torque

prescribed_soil_nailing.testing_protocol: 2% of production nails subjected to sacrificial pullout test up to 1.5x design working pullout capacity

500_kJ.mesh_type: High-tensile steel wire ring net (ROCCO 16-ring, 3mm wire)
500_kJ.energy_dissipators: Stainless steel friction brake rings on top and bottom support ropes
500_kJ.application: Intermediate road cuts with boulder diameters up to 0.8m

1500_kJ.mesh_type: High-tensile steel wire ring net (ROCCO 19-ring, 3.5mm wire)
1500_kJ.energy_dissipators: Double-acting friction brake rings on top, bottom, and retaining ropes
1500_kJ.application: Steep talus scree and high rockfall frequency corridors (boulder dia <= 1.3m)

3000_kJ.application: High-velocity debris flow gullies and major escarpments (boulder dia <= 1.8m)

flexible_rockfall_and_debris_barriers.debris_flow_clearance: 0.5m to 0.8m bottom clearance for water and fluid slurry passage while retaining coarse boulder fronts

subsurface_directional_drainage.pipe_spec: 50mm to 75mm dia heavy-duty slotted PVC pipe (Schedule 80)
subsurface_directional_drainage.slot_dimensions: 1.0mm to 1.5mm transverse slots @ 10mm c/c with 15% open drainage area
subsurface_directional_drainage.filter_jacket: Non-woven needle-punched polypropylene geotextile sock (O90 < 0.15mm) to prevent silt piping

drill_parameters.upward_inclination: 5° to 10° upward rake for gravity self-cleansing flow
drill_parameters.standard_spacing_m: 3.0 m to 6.0 m c/c staggered across slope face or wall base
drill_parameters.effective_length_m: 15.0 m to 30.0 m (must penetrate min 5.0m beyond active shear plane into sound bedrock)

slope_maintenance_inspection_regime.design_code: CEDD Geoguide 5: Guide to Slope Maintenance

RMI.name: Routine Maintenance Inspection
RMI.frequency: Monthly during monsoon season (June–September) and quarterly in dry season
RMI.personnel: Junior Field Staff / Highway Section Observer
RMI.key_checks: Clearance of catchwater drains, removal of vegetative debris from weep holes, observation of fresh tension cracks

EIM.name: Engineer Inspection for Maintenance
EIM.frequency: Every 2 years for Category 1 slopes; every 5 years for Category 2/3 slopes
EIM.key_checks: Structural integrity of retaining walls, soil nail head pad displacement, crack gauge monitoring, drainage gradient verification

DSA.name: Detailed Stability Assessment
DSA.frequency: Immediate upon occurrence of major slope failure (>50 m³ displaced volume) or active tension cracking (>10mm aperture)
DSA.personnel: Senior Geotechnical Engineering Specialist / Academic Panel
DSA.key_checks: Subsurface core drilling, limit equilibrium back-analysis (Bishop / Morgenstern-Price), kinematic rock joint stereonet audit
